locator: Results, section Ground effect, and Fig. 12; model L3 (fins spread) and model N (body only); forces measured at 0 deg attack
definition: r = h / b, flight height over half wing span (b = S/2, S the full pectoral span)

measured.note: drag starts to fall below r = 0.97; maximum reduction at r = 0.33

lift_to_drag: increased with decreasing r from r = 0.35 (solid) and r = 0.97 (water); values read from the text, not the figure
qualifiers: The wind tunnel's water surface could not move with the air, so the authors expect a bigger drag reduction in the real situation (slip velocity of the sea surface).
No measurement below r = 0.21 (solid) or 0.33 (water); the simulator holds the r = 0.33 reduction constant below it and says so.
Lift-to-drag ratio values at each r are in Fig. 12B, which was not read; only the drag percentages stated in the text are used.
simulator_model: drag multiplier f(r) = 1 for r >= 0.97; linear from 1 at r = 0.97 to 0.86 at r = 0.33 (water surface, model L3); 0.86 held for r < 0.33. Lift unchanged.
